cases.description: Verify that a newly created Zone instance returns DClass.IN (value 1) from getDClass().
Call getDClass() twice on the same Zone instance and ensure both calls return the same constant 1.
Create two separate Zone instances and verify each returns DClass.IN (1) independently.
Serialize a newly created Zone instance to a byte array, deserialize it back, and verify that getDClass() still returns DClass.IN (value 1).
Create a dummy RRset, add it to the Zone via addRRset(), then call getDClass() and confirm it still returns 1.
Create a simple Record (e.g., an A record), add it using addRecord(), and verify that getDClass() continues to return 1.
Add an RRset, remove it with removeRRset(), and ensure getDClass() still returns 1.
Obtain an iterator from the Zone (iterator()), iterate over any elements (or none), and then call getDClass() to confirm it returns 1.
Invoke toMasterFile() on a Zone instance and subsequently call getDClass(); the method must still return 1.
